system.notes:
Staff (d6). 3 Gift Dice — casts spells (Bind, Fireball, Disguise are good picks). SAVE 15: he shrugs off most gift effects thrown at him.

Morwenna's field commander, embedded in Drakenshire's court. Created Sir Damon, engineered the body-swap necklaces, planted them on Princess Amy.

Carries intelligence documents revealing Morwenna's operations and stronghold, and a Grimoire with instructions for creating a humanoid servant like Damon.

Duplicitous: if his ruse is discovered he sets Damon on the party; he may instead pretend to ally so they lead him to the lair.
